note: review score for a category and a month; last year is 2017; one score per order, as in the other review examples
question: what was the average review score of products in the health_beauty category in may of last year
golden_sql: SELECT AVG(score) FROM (SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS score FROM order_reviews AS r WHERE DATE(r.review_creation_date) <= '2018-09-01' AND r.order_id IN (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) = 'health_beauty' AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017-05') GROUP BY r.order_id)

note: top three states of a year; only the names are compared
question: which were the top 3 states with the most orders in 2017
golden_sql: SELECT c.customer_state FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.customer_state LIMIT 3

note: three categories with the shortest delivery time; no minimum count was asked for; only the names are compared
question: which 3 categories had the lowest average delivery time in august 2018
golden_sql: SELECT category FROM (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS days FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(o.order_delivered_customer_date) <= '2018-09-01' AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018-08') WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(days), category LIMIT 3
